text: Delivered in 0ec200d. The universal OperatorProgram has typed frame variables and exact parameterizations, a closed seven-case BaseObjective (trace, cross-trace, generalized Rayleigh, trace ratio, ratio trace, disagreement, sequential cross-regression), typed normalization/penalty/constraint catalogs, whole-program result-semantics inference, fitted FunctionalFrame results, and named GPCA/LDA/CCA/PLSC/multiset builders. multivar-ir has a stable descriptor-only JSON seam referencing operators by ValueIdentity. Verification: multivar 291/291 JVM and JS; multivar-ir 12/12 JVM and 10/10 JS; focused program suites 7/7 per platform and IR 1/1 per platform.
